card.name: Spots just before odd letter strings
card.fires_on: Marks inside web addresses, citation codes and biosimilar drug-name suffixes, where an unusual short letter string comes next. Also the command name tar at the start of a shell line.

modes.label: URL and DOI pieces
modes.description: Digits, slashes or domain endings inside web addresses and citation codes.

modes.label: Biosimilar suffix
modes.description: The -a joined to Ustekinumab, right before the letters ekn.
modes.example: visually inspect Ustekinumab<<-a>>ekn for particulate matter

modes.label: Command or title word
modes.description: A shell command or a word in a music title.

card.writes: It promotes short letter pieces like bk, ba, ni, mi and si, which suggests it expects a short lowercase letter string next.
card.plain: It fires where a short odd letter code, such as a web address piece or drug name ending, is about to follow.
